description: Get a fast PhysicsAI estimate of thermal or flow performance for a design, in seconds, instead of a full CFD run. Small GPU charge. Not a substitute for a simulation when the user needs a solver result or the design is outside the model's range. Submit PhysicsAI inference for an owned geometry-design artifact and an explicit immutable release. This is inference, not CFD or model training. Returns a job ID.

ElectronicsConditions.description:
SI operating conditions supported by the electronics v014 adapter.

Bounds limit input abuse and invalid physics, not a promise of accuracy.
The model catalogue states the narrower, operator-qualified envelope.

idempotency_key.description: Use a fresh unique key for each new job, even with identical inputs or a matching finished job. Reuse it unchanged only to retry or resume that same intended job, an uncertain submission included.

notify_url.description: Optional public HTTPS URL sent a signed notification when the job finishes, so you need not poll.
